per_subject: ART screenshot through a one-hour signed URL

availability_policy.numeric_values_require: metric_availability true and a finite numeric value
availability_policy.legacy_values_without_availability: unavailable until original evidence is verified
availability_policy.contiguous_outliers: Count flagged ART volume rows in acquisition order
availability_policy.denoising: Native CONN QA requires visual review; exported tSNR and DVARS are preprocessed before denoising

sample.version: SHA-256 of the ordered included subject identifiers
sample.on_exclusion_change: Existing second-level results become stale and blocked
sample.unblock: A current versioned second-level result requires a passed executed-model audit for the reviewed sample.
sample.history: Earlier group results and artifacts remain immutable and addressable

states.technical_completeness: Whether execution and required artifacts completed
states.subject_quality: Current investigator decision for every subject
states.scientific_acceptance: Versioned investigator decision for the analysis
acceptance_gate: every subject is accepted or excluded
second-level results are current for the effective sample
quantitative ART evidence is available and internally consistent for included subjects
saved model audit verifies sample, design, rank, residual degrees of freedom and contrast
